hero.description: A local meetup for frontend developers, application architects and anyone who wants to build a better web with Vue.js. An evening full of practical case studies, fresh ideas and networking.

spaczek.desc: A Senior Frontend Developer with many years of experience in Vue.js, TypeScript and building open-source Design Systems. He has worked on eCommerce and medtech projects. As an active community member, he is committed to sharing knowledge and promoting industry best practices.

nieduzak.desc: Product Developer and co-organiser of Vue.js Wrocław. He will show that apps which open without internet and run as fast as native ones can be built in Vue — without a separate mobile team and without waiting for app store approval.

rakowski.desc: Co-creator of Vue Storefront and co-founder of Alokai, where he works on the architecture of large e-commerce platforms. He will talk about how to apply Domain Driven Design in Vue applications.

wrzalek.desc: Senior Product Engineer at Lette, Vue.js Advocate and author of Vue articles on DEV. He will show how to build a micro-frontend app in Vue 3, connect independent apps with Vite and Single-SPA, how they communicate and route, and what problems you may run into along the way.

bonusSpeaker.label: Bonus speaker
bonusSpeaker.sub: Leads the Staff Augmentation department at Monterail, has been recruiting for over 7 years and is a career advisor and career coach. She will talk about how to find meaning in a world of a million possibilities.

talks.nieduzak: Vue offline-first: an app that is not in the App Store
